name: @aone-execution/desktop
description: Installable desktop host for the local Aone Execution workbench.

scripts.prepare:tauri: npm run build:workbench && npm run build:sidecar && npm run sync:skills
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean:mac-bundles && npm run prepare:tauri && CI=true tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.check: npm run build:sidecar && npm run sync:skills && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run build:sidecar && npm run sync:skills && node --test test/*.test.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
